logline: Tarek counts forty-one days so the line will mean he is going somewhere. The noise stops. He leaves tea by her closed door.
audience: People about 16 to 35 who feel that their days are unanswered, watching on a phone.
intent: The silence stays. He leaves tea for someone who will not thank him.
style_block: A small rented room before dawn, dim and leaning dark, one weak lamp, no daylight, muted grey-brown, a little disordered, ordinary and unglamorous, 35mm film grain, one small fridge at the left edge of the frame and partly in view, subjects centered in a vertical frame.

characters.description: Fictional man in his early twenties with medium olive-brown skin, a tired ordinary face, short dark hair, and a black hoodie. Not pale, not deep black skin. Lips closed, resting, not smiling, not excited, not grieving. Not a likeness of any real person.

references.prompt: Front view, head and shoulders, looking at the camera. Medium olive-brown skin, black hoodie, lips closed, resting, not smiling. Dim room, one weak lamp. Centered. No text, no logo.
Close view of the same face, awake, lips closed, no smile, no tears, no frown. Medium olive-brown skin, black hoodie. Centered. No text.

Full figure standing still inside a small dim room before dawn, black hoodie, hands at his sides, lips closed, not smiling. The room is a little disordered: a jacket on a chair, a few dishes, papers on the table. One weak lamp, no daylight, no hallway. Centered in a vertical frame. No text.

voice.name: Schedar
voice.style: Dry, measured, low-register restraint. Spoken quietly as an internal realization rather than a performance. Tired, lucid, unsentimental, with a breath between thoughts.

music.caption: Low instrumental bed in D minor at 60 bpm. Sustained strings and a soft drone, no vocals, no drums, no bright melody, and no hopeful ending. Quiet under a spoken voice, and audible in the long silences.

shots.reason: He is trying to turn counted days into proof of direction.

narration.text: Forty-one days without missing. You tell yourself you're going.
narration.subtitle_en:
Forty-one days without missing.
You tell yourself you're going.
narration.delivery: Slightly brisk, matter-of-fact, like reciting a routine. A short breath before the first word.

image.prompt: He stays inside one dim room and holds one phone at his chest in his right hand. The screen reads 41. His left arm hangs at his side. A few papers and a mug sit on the table. Black hoodie, lips closed, face visible. No second person. No hand enters from the edge.

motion.prompt: The thumb taps once. The camera stays locked off.

shots.reason: Noise is used to crowd out quiet thought.

narration.text: If another voice is loud enough, you don't have to hear your own.
narration.subtitle_en:
If another voice is loud enough,
you don't have to hear your own.
narration.delivery: Slightly brisk, matter-of-fact, like reciting a routine. Leave a breath after the last word.

image.prompt: He stands inside the same dim room with white earbuds in both ears. One foot is slightly forward. A jacket hangs on a chair. A closed door is behind him. Black hoodie, lips closed. No hallway, no outdoors.

motion.prompt: He shifts his weight once. The camera stays inside the room.

shots.reason: Living is treated as an exact measurement.

narration.delivery: No speech. Timer and water only.

image.prompt: Inside the same dim room, a kitchen timer counts down beside a glass filled to a marked line. A few dishes sit nearby. His hand in a black hoodie sleeve rests by the glass. No outdoor view.

motion.prompt: The timer ticks. The camera does not move.

shots.reason: A person's morning is reduced to a scheduling entry.

narration.text: People you love get filed as tasks. Five a.m. Alarm set. Done.
narration.subtitle_en:
People you love, filed as tasks.
Five a.m. Alarm set. Done.
narration.delivery: Flat, clipped, like reading a checklist. A breath after Done.

image.prompt: He stands inside the room beside a closed door. Plain dark work shoes are on the floor. He does not look down. A phone is in one hand. A little clutter by the door. Black hoodie, lips closed. No hallway.

motion.prompt: He steps past the shoes inside the room. The camera stays with him.

shots.reason: When the noise stops, the bare room remains.

narration.text: Then the track runs out. And the room is just... there.
narration.subtitle_en:
Then the track runs out.
And the room is just... there.
narration.delivery: Flat, quiet, almost a whisper. Pause after the first sentence. No gasp.

image.prompt: One earbud hangs from one ear. He is still inside the dim room. The fridge is behind him. The window is dark. A few dishes on the counter. Black hoodie, lips closed. No street, no bus.

motion.prompt: The earbud sways once and stops. The camera stays still.

shots.reason: The want for a reason is left with nothing to do.

image.prompt: He stands still inside the dim room, both hands empty, no phone. The counter is a little untidy. Black hoodie, lips closed, resting face. One weak lamp.

motion.prompt: He barely breathes. The camera is locked off.

shots.reason: The morning arrives with no meaning attached to it.

narration.text: You wait for morning to matter. It doesn't. It's just light.
narration.subtitle_en:
You wait for morning to matter.
It doesn't. It's just light.
narration.delivery: Quiet, flat, unsentimental. No dramatic drop on the last word. A breath after it.

image.prompt: He stands inside the dim room. A dark window is visible beside him. Grey light only, leaning dark. A chair with a jacket. Black hoodie, lips closed. No clock, no watch.

motion.prompt: He stays still. The camera does not.

shots.reason: Without an outside answer, care for another person still matters.

narration.text: Nobody's coming to explain it. She still has to be up by six.
narration.subtitle_en:
Nobody's coming to explain it.
She still has to be up by six.
narration.delivery: Grounded, sober, steady. Clear-eyed, without melodrama. A breath between the two sentences.

image.prompt: He looks from his empty hands toward a closed door inside the same room. No light under the door. A little clutter on the counter. Black hoodie, lips closed.

motion.prompt: His gaze shifts from his hands to the closed door. The camera is still.

shots.reason: He steps away from the diversion without announcing it.

narration.delivery: No speech. His hand leaves the phone.

image.prompt: A phone lies on the untidy counter inside the room, screen still lit. His hand has left it. Black hoodie, lips closed. He stays in the room.

motion.prompt: His hand pulls back from the phone. The camera stays locked off.

shots.reason: He knows the care does not fix the morning, and he does it anyway.

narration.text: It doesn't fix anything. Tomorrow the earbuds go back in.
narration.subtitle_en:
It doesn't fix anything.
Tomorrow the earbuds go back in.
narration.delivery: Soft, unhurried, slightly wry and dry. Honest, without defeat. A breath after the last word.

image.prompt: Inside the dim room, a plain kettle heats on a small stove. He pours tea into a plain mug. The counter is a little untidy. Black hoodie, lips closed, face ordinary, not smiling.

motion.prompt: Steam rises. He pours slowly. The camera stays inside the room.

shots.reason: A small act of care, with the door still closed.

narration.text: Still. The tea is hot. She's right behind that door.
narration.subtitle_en:
Still. The tea is hot.
She's right behind that door.
narration.delivery: Soft, unhurried, quiet. Warmth without sentimentality. A breath after the last word.

image.prompt: He sets a plain mug of tea on the floor beside a closed door, still inside the room. He does not knock. The door stays shut. A little clutter nearby. Black hoodie, lips closed.

motion.prompt: He sets the mug down, does not knock, and stays still. The camera holds on the closed door.
